evals.name: should-trigger-single-user-story
evals.prompt: Implement the user story UPEX-277. It's the empty-states story for the dashboard.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates sprint-development in single-story mode. Runs the 12-step workflow: epic precheck, Jira transition Ready-For-Dev -> In Progress, Stage 1 Planning (story-implementation-plan.md), Stage 2 Implementation (code + unit tests, may invoke /unit-testing for TDD slices), Stage 3 Code Review (review-pr.md, transitions to In Review), Stage 4 Staging Deploy. Pauses for user OK before each stage transition.

evals.name: should-trigger-bug-fix
evals.prompt: Fix bug PROJ-445: checkout button broken on mobile. Root-cause it first, then fix.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates sprint-development in bug-fix mode. Reads bug-fix-workflow.md reference. Runs root-cause analysis BEFORE proposing a fix (reproduce, isolate, identify the offending commit/component), drafts the minimal fix plan, then implements, opens PR, and transitions Jira. Adds a regression test to prevent reintroduction.

evals.name: should-trigger-resume-work
evals.prompt: Continue from where I left off on UPEX-100 — I think I had the API done but the UI wasn't wired yet.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates sprint-development in continue-implementation mode. Reads continue-implementation.md reference. Loads the .context/PBI/epics/EPIC-<KEY>-<slug>/stories/STORY-UPEX-100-<slug>/ folder to recover state (synced implementation-plan, local session notes), inspects git status + recent commits to detect actual progress, summarizes what's done vs pending, asks user OK before resuming the next stage.

evals.name: should-trigger-code-review
evals.prompt: Code review for PR #123 — please go through it before I merge.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates sprint-development in Stage 3 Code Review mode. Reads review-pr.md reference. Fetches the PR via gh, walks the diff, checks adherence to project-dev-guide and code-standards, flags issues with severity, posts inline review comments, produces a final verdict (approve / request-changes / comment). Does not merge automatically.

evals.name: should-trigger-staging-deploy
evals.prompt: Deploy to staging once the tests are green on the PR for UPEX-200.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates sprint-development in Stage 4 Staging Deploy mode. Verifies CI is green via gh, merges the PR (after user OK), triggers the staging deploy workflow, monitors until completion, posts the staging URL + version to Jira, transitions the ticket to Ready-For-QA. Does NOT auto-deploy to production (gated separate step).

evals.name: should-accept-business-maps-without-prd-srs
evals.prompt: Implement BK-42 on our adopted app. We never wrote a PRD or SRS; the business maps, dev guide and glossary are generated.
evals.expected_behavior: Pre-requisites pass on the business-maps form: `.context/PRD/` and `.context/SRS/` hold only their READMEs, but `bun run context:map business-data-context` prints sections. No fast-fail and no suggestion to write a PRD or SRS. Stage 1 reads the architecture record from `business-api-context` `architecture` + `business-data-context` `overview` + `.context/business/project-dev-guide.md` and `.context/ADR/`; data model from the data map's `entities` / `access-control` / `migrations`; the API contract from the app's OpenAPI spec when present, else `auth-model` / `journey-<slug>` and the feature map's `route-inventory`; UI copy from the glossary and the live UI. A placeholder map the story needs is a `missing_input` that recommends `/project-context <mode>`.

evals.name: should-fast-fail-without-any-product-docs
evals.prompt: Implement BK-7. The repo has no PRD, no SRS and the business maps are still placeholders.
evals.expected_behavior: Fast-fails at Pre-requisites because neither product-doc set exists. Hands off to /project-foundation when the product is still being defined, or /project-context data when the app's code already exists. Does not write a PRD, an SRS or a map itself, and does not start Stage 1.

evals.name: should-keep-srs-inputs-when-prd-srs-exist
evals.prompt: Implement UPEX-310, a new backend endpoint. This project went through /project-foundation, so PRD and SRS are there.
evals.expected_behavior: PRD/SRS path, unchanged: Pre-requisites pass on the PRD/SRS form. Stage 1 reads `.context/SRS/architecture-specs.md` and `.context/ADR/` as input 9, Stage 2 reads `.context/SRS/api-contracts.yaml` for the backend contract, and UI copy follows the glossary plus the PRD `executive-summary.md` / `user-personas.md`. Business maps remain optional inputs; a missing one is a `missing_input` note, not a blocker.

evals.name: should-run-greenfield-verification-unchanged
evals.prompt: Implementa UPEX-210 en este proyecto recién creado desde el boilerplate (stack: con los defaults del schema).
evals.expected_behavior: Reads `stack:` from `.agents/project.yaml` with input 1. With the greenfield defaults the verification cap=3 resolves to exactly the commands the skill always ran: `bun run lint:check`, `bun run types:check`, `bun run test`, the dev server is `bun run dev`, the PR base is `git_strategy.branches.integration` (or production when null), and a schema change goes through the DB MCP (`migrations_tool: supabase-mcp`, `list_migrations` read first, no migration file). Nothing in the run differs from the pre-parametrization behaviour.

evals.name: should-use-the-adopted-apps-script-names
evals.prompt: Implement BK-77 on this adopted app. Its stack block says package_manager bun, scripts.lint: lint, scripts.types: null, scripts.test: test:unit, app_root: apps/web.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs verification from `apps/web` as `bun run lint` and `bun run test:unit`; the `types` role is null, so that check is skipped and named in the report as skipped (no invented `tsc` call, no script added to the app's package.json). The agentic tooling (`bun run jira:sync-issues`, `bun run context:map`) still runs from the repo root.

evals.name: should-target-production-when-integration-is-null
evals.prompt: Open the PR for UPEX-88 and take it through Stage 4. git_strategy is solo-main with branches.integration: null.
evals.expected_behavior: Opens the PR against `git_strategy.branches.production` through /git-flow-master, never against a literal `staging` or `develop`. Stage 4 verifies the PR's preview deployment instead of merging into an integration branch; the merge to production is Stage 5, gated.

evals.name: should-apply-schema-change-per-migrations-tool
evals.prompt: The story needs a new `invoices.due_date` column. stack.database.migrations_tool is prisma, migrations_dir prisma/migrations.
evals.expected_behavior: Loads /supabase + /supabase-postgres-best-practices, reads the migration history through the DB MCP (`list_migrations`) first, then lets the app's own Prisma tool generate the migration and asks before the team's pipeline applies it; the MCP stays read-only (an `apply_migration` around Prisma would never reach Prisma's migrations table). After it runs, the live column is re-read through the MCP and the database types are regenerated. Per `agentic-dev-core/references/db-change-doctrine.md`.

evals.name: should-not-stop-a-non-db-story-for-the-db-capability
evals.prompt: Implementa UPEX-301: cambiar el texto del botón de checkout. No hay DB MCP conectado en esta sesión.
evals.expected_behavior: Proceeds: the story's plan touches no schema, RLS, function or data, so capability `db` does not bind it (`## Stack parameters`; mcp-capabilities §4 optional steps). It would STOP only if the plan needed a database change.

evals.name: should-keep-the-apps-testid-convention
evals.prompt: Add the new filter dropdown for BK-90. The app already marks elements with data-test="kebab-case" ids and stack.conventions.testid_style is null.
evals.expected_behavior: Follows the app's existing convention (`data-test`, kebab-case) for the new elements instead of the `data-testid` camelCase/snake_case defaults of references/data-testid-standards.md, and renames no existing test id. A reviewer flags a departure from the app's convention, not from the reference's default.

evals.name: should-not-overwrite-an-existing-ci-workflow
evals.prompt: Set up CI for this project (first time). The repo already has .github/workflows/ci.yml running lint and build on main.
evals.expected_behavior: Follows references/ci-cd-setup.md Paso 0: the existing `ci.yml` is never replaced, renamed or written over. It reports what the workflow covers, and proposes only the missing jobs (types, test, the integration deploy) as a NEW workflow with its own name or as a diff to approve; nothing is written without the user's OK.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-ac-refinement
evals.prompt: Refine the AC for UPEX-277 — the criteria are vague and I want them as Gherkin before we code.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate sprint-development. Should route to /product-management (acceptance-criteria.md reference) because AC refinement happens BEFORE implementation. sprint-development assumes the story is Ready-For-Development; refining AC mid-flight is a sign the story shouldn't have been pulled into the sprint yet.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-standalone-unit-tests
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for this calculate-discount function — TDD style, red-green-refactor.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate sprint-development. Should route to /unit-testing because the request is standalone unit-test design, not full-story implementation. sprint-development MAY invoke /unit-testing internally for TDD slices, but a direct unit-test request bypasses the orchestrator.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-regression-suite
evals.prompt: Run the regression test suite on staging and tell me if we can release.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate sprint-development. Regression testing is out of scope for this repo (QA workflow). sprint-development's Stage 4 deploys to staging but does not run formal regression.
